title: Measured recovery of whole-book scoped validation and publication
question: Can the scoped book work progress through native named-link admission and publication without repeatedly scanning the same retained reports?
method: Observe the active native completion and use PostgreSQL statement counters. Time bounded read-only queries against the same retained annotation and report. Materialize expected and reported named cues separately, and extract source keys once per publication input. Compare retained Python and independent native readings, then measure the first completed replacement batch.

uv run ci model change deploy 911ea44adece4477b417d3115ef0f84a --json

conclusion: The materialized named-cue check cleared the earlier bottleneck while preserving independent reconstruction. Independent predicate checks distinguish genuine example discourse from numbered references. Reading publication keys before expanding contributions allowed the replacement batch to publish. Run 321/cut 435 contains eight exact source views and 30,437 admitted contributions.
